description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the business license recognition feature (RecognizeBusinessLicense)
description_zh: 本文介绍营业执照识别RecognizeBusinessLicense的语法及示例
name: RecognizeBusinessLicense

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

Address.description_en: The company address. `FailInRecognition` is returned if recognition fails
Address.description_zh: 公司地址。识别失败时返回`FailInRecognition`
Address.example: 浙江省杭州市西湖区转塘科技经济区块888号888幢

Angle.description_en: The angle of the input image (clockwise rotation). Valid values: 0, 90, 180, and 270
Angle.description_zh: 输入图片的角度（顺时针旋转）。枚举值包括：0、90、180、270

Business.description_en: The business scope. `FailInRecognition` is returned if recognition fails
Business.description_zh: 经营范围。识别失败时返回`FailInRecognition`
Business.example: 网络技术服务；网站建设；销售：I类医疗器械、保健用品（不含保健食品）等

Capital.description_en: The registered capital. `FailInRecognition` is returned if recognition fails
Capital.description_zh: 注册资本。识别失败时返回`FailInRecognition`

Emblem.description_en: The national emblem position. `FailInDetection` is returned if detection fails
Emblem.description_zh: 国徽位置。识别失败时返回`FailInDetection`

Left.description_en: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the region

Top.description_en: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the region

EstablishDate.description_en: The company registration date. For example, if the certificate shows "2014年04月16日", the API returns "20140416"
EstablishDate.description_zh: 公司注册日期。例如证件上为“2014年04月16日”，则接口返回“20140416”

LegalPerson.description_en: The legal representative. `FailInRecognition` is returned if recognition fails
LegalPerson.description_zh: 公司法人。识别失败时返回`FailInRecognition`

Name.description_en: The company name. `FailInRecognition` is returned if recognition fails
Name.description_zh: 公司名称。识别失败时返回`FailInRecognition`
Name.example: 某某电子商务有限公司

QRCode.description_en: The QR code position. `FailInDetection` is returned if detection fails
QRCode.description_zh: 二维码位置。识别失败时返回`FailInDetection`

Left.description_en: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the region

Top.description_en: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the region

RegisterNumber.description_en: The unified social credit code. `FailInRecognition` is returned if recognition fails
RegisterNumber.description_zh: 统一社会信用代码。识别失败时返回`FailInRecognition`

Stamp.description_en: The stamp position. `FailInDetection` is returned if detection fails
Stamp.description_zh: 印章位置。识别失败时返回`FailInDetection`

Left.description_en: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the region

Top.description_en: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the region

Title.description_en: The title position. `FailInDetection` is returned if detection fails
Title.description_zh: 标题位置。识别失败时返回`FailInDetection`

Left.description_en: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the region

Top.description_en: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the region

Type.description_en: The company type. `FailInRecognition` is returned if recognition fails
Type.description_zh: 公司类型。识别失败时返回`FailInRecognition`

ValidPeriod.description_en:
The end date of the business license validity period. For example, if the certificate shows "2014年04月16日至2034年04月15日", the API returns "20340415".

The current algorithm outputs dates in the "YYYYMMDD" format (for example, "20391130") and uses "29991231" to represent "long-term"
ValidPeriod.description_zh:
公司营业期限终止日期。例如证件上为“2014年04月16日至2034年04月15日”，则接口返回“20340415”。

当前算法将日期格式统一输出为“年月日”（例如“20391130”），并用“29991231”表示“长期”
